utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Wrap it around again. Go through another one of these loops. Pull it out. Do it again. Just do a whole line of that. Can you do the first line? Like that? Like a long line?

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Like a long line? Yeah, that's called a chain. That's a single crochet.

utterances.speaker: grandfather
utterances.text: Probably what's left of the baseball bat, the one you were playing. He'd never had a proper chain.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Okay. So let's— Make a long line like that. Wrap it around your fingers over here.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Oh, that reminds me! I actually knitted a whole blanket with this thick blue yarn once. It took me three months and I had to use these massive needles that looked like drumsticks. Everyone in the dorm wanted one.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Honey, your yarn is falling off your hand. You aren't listening to the tension part. If you don't wrap it twice, the loops will just go limp. Here, let me grab your wrist— stop moving for a second.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Wait, I'm almost at the end of the row though! If I stop now, I'll lose my place in the story.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: If you don't stop, you'll lose the whole blanket. Hold still. I'm re-wrapping this for you because you've let it go completely slack while you were talking about those drumsticks.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Here. Here. So I do this.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: For 1 minute. I'm going to try something.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: You can just do it that way, huh?

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: I actually knitted a blanket like this once. It's really cool.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: And you turn to come back. Wrap it around your fingers. That keeps it tense. And you make one, and then you make one in the next one.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Make another one? I can't see them too well to go through there.
